sections.overdosage: Overdose of examplamine can cause severe agitation, hypertension, tachycardia, hyperthermia, seizures, and cardiovascular collapse. Overdose is a medical emergency. Management is supportive; there is no specific antidote. Contact a poison control center.
sections.warnings: Examplamine carries a risk of abuse and dependence. Use the lowest effective dose.
